data: Amazon reported diluted earnings per share of $5.53 for fiscal 2024, up from $2.90 in fiscal 2023, an increase of about 90.7%. Net income for fiscal 2024 was $59.2 billion, compared with $30.4 billion in fiscal 2023. These figures come from Amazon's fiscal 2024 annual report, and you may want to check them against the 10-K filing.
